metadata.method: Warm both target-only and speculative paths per coding task, then two alternating paired greedy cycles and one paired stochastic cycle. Single request at a time; prefix cache disabled. Decode rate excludes first token. Long prefill uses repeated input IDs.
metadata.precision: NVFP4 weight-only RTN; BF16 MoE activations
metadata.uncommitted_inference_changes: Naive expert mapper selects compact E4M3 NVFP4; no operator changes
metadata.logit_reference: Current FastLLM FP8 implementation with original checkpoint; not a fresh Transformers reference
